tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Company registered with the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India - IRDAI
GST certificate copy along with latest GST returns filed for 3 months copy should be enclosed.
Income tax returns of last Five years with profit and loss balance sheet and PAN number.
Insurance company should have at least minimum existing 3 client as Group Medical Insurance and provide the list of the same.
Notarized copy of self-declaration for not blacklisted on Rs. 200/- non-judicial bond paper.
The company should be in existence for more than 3 years, Registration certificate of the Company as per IRDAI Regulatory Act
The company should have experience in Group Term Insurance. Details for orders executed to reputed companies for the last 3 years shall be enclosed.
The Company should have provided the similar type of services
The Company should have rendered the similar type of services
The Company should quote Premium Amount and applicable taxes separately for the entire year
The tenderer should not be in Blacklist or Defaulter in any department of Government of Karnataka, A Self-declaration shall be enclosed.
